defect: signed index is compared as an unsigned value
rationale: The signed index_i is converted to unsigned for the comparison because limit_i is unsigned, so a negative index is treated as a large positive index and fails the lower-bound test.

mutation.description: Changed the converted one-hot index to signed while leaving the comparison limit unsigned.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the one-hot conversion consumer to its signed index comparison.
